name: Hermes Model Swapper
description: Bar widget that hot-swaps the Hermes Agent between local model servers. Left click cycles to the next profile, middle click re-reads the live Hermes config. Install: omarchy plugin add https://github.com/Evilutionary66/omarchy-hermes-swapper --enable
author: Evilutionary66

barWidget.description: Swap Hermes Agent between LM Studio and Strata without leaving the bar.
